Recruiting Body: West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB), Araksha Bhawan
Educational Qualification: Madhyamik Examination passed from WBBSE or equivalent + Ability to read, write and speak Bengali (exempt for hill sub-divisions)
Age Bracket: 18 to 30 Years as on 1st January (OBC +3 yrs, SC/ST +5 yrs, Civic Volunteers relaxation)
Physical Standards (PMT/PET): Male: Height 167 cm, Chest 78-83 cm | 1,600m Run in 6.5 Mins; Female: Height 160 cm | 800m Run in 4 Mins
Selection Stages: Written Examination (85 MCQs / 85 Marks) -> Physical Measurement & Efficiency Test (PMT & PET) -> Interview (15 Marks) -> Medical Examination
